t: This is the Church of Christ the King in Gordon Square, Bloomsbury, a Grade I listed building since 1954, one of 129 such Christian buildings in London. It adjoins Dr Williams's Library and is within sight of University College London. The architect was John Raphael Rodrigues Brandon, a Gothic Revival architect and writer, who did much of his work with his brother Joshua until Joshua's death in 1847. Today the Anglican mission Euston Church uses it for Sunday services, and Forward in Faith uses the English Chapel at the east end on weekdays.
